DECLARE @NEXT_CALLLIST_DATE DATETIME

SET @NEXT_CALLLIST_DATE = CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(DAY,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,GETDATE())>=17 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,GETDATE()))

IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##tmpPDSDuplicateMembers') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##tmpPDSDuplicateMembers 
CREATE TABLE ##tmpPDSDuplicateMembers (SBSB_ID VARCHAR(20), RECORD_COUNT INT,SBSB_CK INT)

CREATE TABLE #tmpSingleEligibility (SBSB_ID VARCHAR(20))

CREATE TABLE #tmpOtherEligibility (SBSB_ID VARCHAR(20),SBSB_CK INT,ROWNUM INT)

INSERT INTO ##tmpPDSDuplicateMembers (SBSB_ID,RECORD_COUNT)
SELECT SBSB_ID,COUNT(SBSB_CK) AS RECORD_COUNT
FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
GROUP BY SBSB_ID
HAVING COUNT(SBSB_CK) > 1
	
INSERT INTO #tmpSingleEligibility (SBSB_ID)
SELECT T.SBSB_ID
FROM ##tmpPDSDuplicateMembers T
	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON T.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID
	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.MEME_CK
	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
		AND @NEXT_CALLLIST_DATE BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
GROUP BY T.SBSB_ID
HAVING COUNT(MEPE.MEME_CK) = 1

UPDATE T
SET SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
FROM ##tmpPDSDuplicateMembers T
	INNER JOIN #tmpSingleEligibility SE ON T.SBSB_ID = SE.SBSB_ID
	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON T.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID
	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.MEME_CK
	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
		AND @NEXT_CALLLIST_DATE BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT

INSERT INTO #tmpOtherEligibility (SBSB_ID,SBSB_CK,ROWNUM)
SELECT T.SBSB_ID,SBSB.SBSB_CK,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T.SBSB_ID ORDER BY SBSB.LAST_MODIFIED_DTM DESC)
FROM ##tmpPDSDuplicateMembers T
	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON T.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID
		AND T.SBSB_CK IS NULL
ORDER BY T.SBSB_ID

UPDATE T
SET T.SBSB_CK = OE.SBSB_CK
FROM ##tmpPDSDuplicateMembers T
	INNER JOIN #tmpOtherEligibility OE ON T.SBSB_ID = OE.SBSB_ID
WHERE T.SBSB_CK IS NULL AND OE.ROWNUM = 1
IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##tmpPDSDuplicateMembers') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##tmpPDSDuplicateMembers
